name_reason: The trailing _36107 equals the function's own address (0x00036107), i.e. a Ghidra address residue, not a domain ID. The descriptor 'lx_chunk_read' already fully conveys the role; strip the hex suffix. No collision: search_functions(crt_equivalent_lx_chunk_read) returns only this one symbol. CRT-equivalent wrapper naming convention crt_equivalent_* preserved.
purpose: Mode-flag-dispatched chunk fetcher for the LX module-loader pipeline: copies 'length' bytes into dest either by file read (lseek+read) or in-memory copy (memcpy), selected by mode bit0, and returns the chunk's end position for chained reads.
logic_summary: Computes the return value end = offset + length up front (EBX in the original, before any callee CALL, so it is independent of the helpers' return values). If (mode & 1) == 0: lseek(file_handle, offset, SEEK_SET) then read(file_handle, dest, length) -- file-backed path. Else (bit0 set): memcpy(dest, (void*)(file_handle + offset), length) -- in-memory path, with file_handle reused as a base address. Returns offset + length. cyclomatic complexity 2; callees memcpy(0x3cbd6), lseek(0x3cc00), read(0x3cc4b).
signature: int __cdecl crt_equivalent_lx_chunk_read_36107(int file_handle, int offset, byte mode, void *dest, uint length)

params.name: file_handle
params.semantics: In file mode (bit0 clear) this is the OS file descriptor passed to lseek/read. In memory mode (bit0 set) it is reused as a base address, and memcpy reads from file_handle+offset. The name reflects the primary (file) role; the dual use is documented in the comment.
params.reason: Accurately names the file-mode role (the common path through callers); dual base-address use is explained in the comment. No address residue.

params.name: offset
params.semantics: File seek position (SEEK_SET) in file mode, or byte offset added to the base address in memory mode. Also one of the two addends of the returned end position (offset+length).
params.reason: Correct and generic for both dispatch paths; no address residue.

params.name: mode
params.semantics: Dispatch flag; only bit0 is tested. bit0 clear => file read; bit0 set => in-memory memcpy. Forwarded verbatim by the LX header reader / module loader so every chunk read selects the same backing store.
params.reason: Describes the byte's role as a mode selector; no address residue.

params.name: dest
params.semantics: Destination buffer that receives the 'length' fetched bytes (target of read or memcpy).
params.reason: Clear and correct; no address residue.

params.name: length
params.semantics: Number of bytes to fetch (count for read/memcpy) and the second addend of the returned end position (offset+length).
params.reason: Correct byte-count name; no address residue.

returns.semantics: End position of the chunk = offset + length. Computed before any helper CALL, so it is unaffected by lseek/read/memcpy return values. Callers chain it as the next read's starting offset (e.g. obj_tbl_off = chunk_read(... )) to walk consecutive object-table / page-table / fixup records.
